thumbnail_dir.description: Name of the directory that holds thumbnail images.

default_thumbnail_x.description: Size of the thumbnail images in the x direction (pixels).

default_thumbnail_y.description: Size of the thumbnail images in the y direction (pixels).

thumbnail_threshold.description: If both dimensions of the original are within this much of the thumbnail dimensions we will skip the thumbnail.

med_x.description: Size of the medium images in the x direction (pixels).

med_y.description: Size of the medium images in the y direction (pixels).

med_dir.description: Name of the directory that holds medium images.

med_threshold.description: If both dimensions of the original are within this much of the medium dimensions we will skip creating the medium-size format.

do_recurse.description: Automatically recurse into subdirectories? Set to 1 to enable.

do_medium.description: Generate medium images at all? Set to 1 to enable.

do_slide.description: Generate the slideshow and frame view? Set to 1 to enable.

do_detail.description: Generate the details view? Set to 1 to enable.

do_captions.description: Use/display caption info stored in images? Set to 1 to enable.

do_dirs.description: Process subdirectories as entries in the normal index and details views? Set to 1 to enable.

do_montage.description: Create a montage of all the images? Set to 1 to enable.

do_emoticons.description: Map ASCII smily patterns embedded within an image's comment into real emoticon images? Set to 1 to enable.

do_reverse.description: Sort timestamps in reverse order. Set to 1 to enable.

do_video_files.description: Process video files. Set to 1 to enable.

do_video_thumbnail_icons.description: Overlay a small icon into one of the corners of the thumbnail and medium views for video files? Set to 1 to enable.

video_regexp.description: Regular expression to identify video files by their extension.

video_icon_gravity.description: Corner where video icon is placed (SouthWest, NorthWest, NorthEast, SouthEast).

video_icon.description: Video icon type (1 for yellow dot with play arrow, 2 for purple camera icon).

index_linkto.description: What the hyperlink for the thumbnail image in the index view points to (index, fullsize, medium, thumbnail, slide, details).

details_linkto.description: What the hyperlink for the thumbnail image in the details view points to.

slide_linkto.description: What the hyperlink for the medium image in the slide view points to.

default_columns.description: Default number of columns to use in the index and detail views.

frame_orient.description: Set the orientation of slide frame (horizontal or vertical).

slide_caption.description: Controls if an image caption is retrieved and written into the HTML output and where (top, bottom, none).

slide_date.description: Controls if the date/time of an image is written into the HTML output and where (top, bottom, none).

detailshrink.description: In the detail view, the number of times thumbnail images are shrunk (factor).

thumb_quality.description: Quality of the thumbnails being written out (0-100).

med_quality.description: Quality of the medium images written out (0-100).

montage_min.description: Minimum number of tiles that will be found in a montage image.

montage_max.description: Maximum number of tiles that will be found in a montage.

montage_fill.description: How to fill incomplete montage tiles (repeat or blank).

stylesheet.description: Cascading style sheet content for HTML output rendering.

emptycell.description: Adjust what is presented in empty table cells when there are not an even number of images.

updirtext.description: Control the text of a hyperlink to a parent directory.

framelinktext.description: Control the text of a hyperlink to the frame view.

detaillinktext.description: Control the text of a hyperlink to the detail view.

indexlinktext.description: Control the text of a hyperlink to the index view.

default_titletext.description: Control the default TITLE string written out in the HTML for a given directory.

framethumbtitle.description: Control the TITLE attributes for hyperlinks to thumbnail images within the frame view.

indexthumbtitle.description: Control the TITLE attributes for hyperlinks to thumbnail images within the index view.

slidethumbtitle.description: Control the TITLE attributes for hyperlinks to thumbnail images within the slide view.

detailthumbtitle.description: Control the TITLE attributes for hyperlinks to thumbnail images within the detail view.

montagetitle.description: Control the TITLE attributes for hyperlinks to montage images within the index view.

file_charset.description: Control which charset the generated html pages should have.

framedateformat.description: Control the way the date is formed in the frame view.

frametimeformat.description: Control the way the time is formed in the frame view.

indexdateformat.description: Control the way the date is formed in the index view.

indextimeformat.description: Control the way the time is formed in the index view.

slidedateformat.description: Control the way the date is formed in the slide view.

slidetimeformat.description: Control the way the time is formed in the slide view.

detaildateformat.description: Control the way the date is formed in the detail view.

detailtimeformat.description: Control the way the time is formed in the detail view.

indexfile.description: Control what the index view's HTML filename will be.

detailfile.description: Control what the detail view's HTML filename will be.

framefile.description: Control what the frame view's HTML filename will be.

slidefile.description: Control what the slide view's HTML filename will be.

slide_dir.description: Control the name of the directory where all the slide view HTML files will be deposited.

stylefile.description: Control the name of the cascading style sheet written out in each directory.

montagefile.description: Control the name of the montage image if enabled.

emoticonprefix.description: Control the prefix of the emoticon PNG image filenames.
